This name is not directly mentioned in the Bible, but the root 'Padda' is found in various contexts, such as 'Padan-Aram' (Genesis 12:5), which means 'the land of Aram' or 'the land of the judgment of El'.

in_greek.name: Πάδδος

in_latin.name: Patricius
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Paddy in Latin is 'Patricius'. It is derived from the Latin word 'patricius', which means 'patriarch' or 'nobleman'. This name is not directly mentioned in the Bible, but it was popular among early Christians and saints, such as Saint Patrick of Ireland.
